budget_items.what_was_recorded: Commission expects Lorden to pay the full betterment, stated as around $1.5 million; ZBA seemed to want to cut a deal.
budget_items.quote: that we expect lorden to pay the full betterment (around $1.5million)

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Discussion that a 40B project can receive only a 25% reduction in betterment, with the rest of the town paying full betterments.
People on Pratt Street are looking at a fee of $24,000.
budget_items.quote: the people on pratt street are looking at a fee of $24,000.

budget_items.topic: Highland St. betterment and privilege fee
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Jean Larkin had heard of a betterment of $5775 and asked about other costs; the $5775 can be paid with taxes and spread over ten years.
budget_items.quote: she'd heard of the betterment of $5775 and asked if there was anything else?

budget_items.topic: Highland St. privilege fee if she joins the extension now
budget_items.what_was_recorded: If she helps pay for the private extension, the privilege fee is $5775 because construction costs are split among residents; it is paid with taxes and can be spread over ten years.
budget_items.quote: then the privilege fee is $5775 because the construction costs are split

budget_items.topic: Highland St. privilege fee after project completion
budget_items.what_was_recorded: If she does the work after the project is completed, the privilege fee jumps to $11,000, the most recent betterment amount.
budget_items.quote: the privilege fee jumps to $11,000, which is the most recent betterment

budget_items.what_was_recorded: With the project in another area of town, the betterment is estimated at $24,000, and anyone participating after assessment pays the $24,000 privilege fee per the Sewer Assessment bylaw.
budget_items.quote: the betterment is estimated to be $24,000.

budget_items.topic: Highland St. privilege fee after town takes over the line
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Martha Cheesman asked to confirm the fee; after the town takes over the line, the privilege fee would be $11,551.
budget_items.quote: but after the town takes over the line, it will be $11,551.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: At a future date, a home connecting to sewer would pay a $3000 connection fee plus a contractor to bring a pipe from the property line to the home.
budget_items.quote: she would pay the $3000 connection fee and a contractor to come and bring a pipe
